title: Picari and RiskMandate

scenes.kicker: RiskMandate · a story made at the summit
scenes.title: Picari and RiskMandate
scenes.caption: For Picari

scenes.title: Where Picari stands, in its own words
items: A buyer-led evaluation platform for security tools
A ranked shortlist no vendor can pay to influence
Scores rest on what vendors can prove, not what they promise
scenes.caption: All of this comes from Picari's own public pages.
say: We start from what Picari already says about itself.
Its principle is that proof counts, and placement cannot be bought. Our five suggestions build on that.

scenes.title: 1. Run GAMMA-Ray on Picari's listings
steps: Every claim linked to its source
scenes.caption: Our suggestion, what we would do together. Not Picari's claim, and nothing of theirs was tested.
say: We would run GAMMA-Ray on the agentic tools in Picari's catalogue.
Seven to eight standards give a second, evidence-graded view a buyer can read, with no confrontation with the vendor.

scenes.title: 2. Rank evidence by assurance level

levels.label: Public
levels.note: Published pages and documents anyone can read.

levels.label: Vendor-commented
levels.note: The vendor has responded to the evidence on record.

levels.label: Customer
levels.note: Evidence that comes from those who use the product.

scenes.caption: Our suggestion: each fact carries a trust level, from public up to regulator.
say: Not all evidence weighs the same, so we would show the level beside every fact.
A buyer sees at a glance how far a claim has climbed.

scenes.title: 3. Openness, not pay-to-play: claim to evidence
scenes.caption: Our suggestion: public, on-record evidence, with every claim tied to its source.
say: Picari says if a vendor hasn't shared the data, you'll know. GAMMA-Ray says 'not yet evidenced'. It is the same idea.
A claim-to-evidence graph makes that gap visible, and money cannot buy a link.

scenes.title: 4. Signed identities for every party and agent
items: Buyers, vendors, reviewers: each one signs what they say
Agents that query or write evidence sign too
SGit vaults keep the signed record
Anyone can see who said what, and when
scenes.caption: Our suggestion: signed identities, with SGit vaults.
say: Picari offers an MCP server so Claude or ChatGPT can query vendor facts.
If agents read the facts, agents and people should both be identified and signed.

scenes.title: 5. Trials for vendors, paid evaluation for buyers

before.label: Today (Picari's pages)
items: Vendors can take part in evaluations

scenes.caption: Our suggestion for how both sides could start. It is not a Picari plan.
say: Vendors could try it with little commitment, and nobody pays for placement.
Buyers could pay for a deeper evaluation. That is our suggestion, to be discussed.

scenes.text: Picari ranks on what vendors can prove. We would make the proof visible, graded and signed.
scenes.caption: Our hypothesis, built from public pages only.
say: The gap between claim and evidence is what both Picari and GAMMA-Ray make visible.
Together, a buyer could read it.

scenes.title: Three ways to start
items: £500 · ABP Tailored: your deployment, reflected in the mandate, corrected by a named security professional (1 to 3 days)
£1,500 · ABP Reviewed: two sessions with your team and a custom vault, signed off by a security professional (1 to 5 days)
£5,000 · A deeper engagement: your agents mapped, mandated and measured with us, end to end
Summit promotion: commit today and take 25% off any of these, or, with the £1,500 or £5,000 package, a tablet set up for you.
scenes.caption: agent@riskmandate.ai · store.sgit.ai
say: Pick the level that fits: tailored, reviewed, or end to end.
